explanation: Youngest son of Isaac and Rebekah, brother to Esau, and ancestor of the twelve tribes of Israel.
Jacob's first wife, older sister to Rachel, and daughter of Laban. She bears six of Jacob's sons and one daughter.
Jacob's favored wife, younger sister to Leah, and daughter of Laban. She is the mother of Joseph and Benjamin.
Father of Leah and Rachel, and uncle to Jacob. He makes agreements with Jacob regarding work and marriage.
A plant associated in the Bible with fertility. Leah receives mandrakes from her son Reuben and trades them for a night with Jacob.
Involuntary inability to have children. Rachel struggles with barrenness before finally becoming the mother of Joseph and Benjamin.
Bilhah and Zilpah, the servant women of Rachel and Leah, who also bear children by Jacob to increase the size of their respective families.
Faith in and devotion to God. Jacob and his family practice worship and acknowledge God's influence in their lives.
Agreement between two parties. Jacob and Laban make a covenant concerning wages and possessions after Jacob has worked for him for several years.
